Trump threatens new China tariffs before election debate

Donald Trump said he could impose new tariffs on China if trade negotiations stall during the campaign.

The proposal became an election issue as companies warned that higher import taxes could lift inflation.

Manufacturers said the policy would affect supply chains, while advisers argued it would pressure Beijing.

Prediction markets focused on whether a new administration would announce tariff measures early in the year.
